text: {"frames":["Something is missing from the schoolroom on the third floor, the chalk box that always sat by the window. You find it in the canal below, where the water shows a candle burning in a window that is not there. The reflection flickers when you lean over the rail, and a small hand writes in wet chalk on the sill. The message says the room must be measured before the door will open. You pace it out with your clogs, board by board. About how many square metres is the classroom?","Please help, calls a voice from the ice, and footprints appear on the canal where no one has walked. They lead in a line across the frozen water, straight to the schoolhouse door at the foot of the Tower. Pim, who keeps the school bench, says the room has been locked since the threads tangled. The footprints stop at a wall where a secret cupboard should be. Before you can open it, you must know how big the classroom is in square metres. How big is the classroom in square metres?","A smell of hot milk and wet wool drifts down the dyke stairs at night. Nobody has seen the watchman who guards the dyke by day, but a lantern glows in the classroom window of the Tower. Lot says the watchman waits until the school floor has been measured. The bell hangs silent, and the clock says nothing. What is the size of the classroom in square metres?","You start up the stairs and count every step with your clogs. Somewhere in the fog a voice counts along with you, one step behind. It stops at the schoolroom door and says the room has been lost for years. The lamp hums, and the door is as cold as ice. The only way in is through the floor, and the floor must be measured first. About how many square metres does the classroom floor cover?","Mind the threads, Thijs says, as he ducks under a line hanging from the mill sails. The threads lead into the fog and tug at the bell rope in the schoolroom. The bell will ring only when someone knows the floor size in square metres. Knots of thread on the wall seem to be waiting for the answer. How big is the classroom, in square metres?"]}
